name: Cable Low Row
instructions: Sit at a low-row station with your feet on the platform, knees slightly bent, and hold the handle with arms extended.
Sit tall with your chest up and shoulders back.
Pull the handle toward your lower abdomen, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Extend your arms slowly, letting your shoulders protract slightly without rounding your back.
longevityNotes: Pulling strength balances all the forward-reaching of daily life and protects the shoulders and upper back. A strong back is one of the best predictors of staying active and independent.
overview: A seated cable row to a low pulley that trains the lats, mid-back and biceps with steady tension.
